name: Athena Balanced Growth Portfolio
investment_objective: Diversified long-term growth with meaningful fixed income ballast and a small defensive reserve.
strategy_description: Diversified long-term growth portfolio with broad equity exposure, fixed income ballast, small alternative allocation and cash reserve.
ips_summary: Target roughly 60% equities, 30% fixed income, 5% alternatives and 5% cash while avoiding excessive single-name concentration.
market_data_coverage: All holdings use deterministic Market Data demo price histories.
fixed_income_assumptions: BND and IEF use demo duration, modified duration and DV01 assumptions.
commentary_focus: Diversification across broad equity, international equity, fixed income, gold and cash.
Moderate equity risk with manageable concentration.
Fixed income provides stabilizing ballast but adds rate sensitivity.

transaction_history.description: Trim growth tilt and add fixed income

name: Athena Conservative Income Portfolio
investment_objective: Income-oriented allocation with lower equity beta and diversified fixed income exposure.
strategy_description: Income-oriented portfolio with higher fixed income exposure and lower equity beta, designed to demonstrate duration and rate sensitivity.
ips_summary: Target roughly 35% equities, 55% fixed income, 5% alternatives and 5% cash with controlled single-position risk.
market_data_coverage: All holdings use deterministic Market Data demo price histories.
fixed_income_assumptions: BND, IEF and TLT use demo ETF duration and DV01 assumptions.
commentary_focus: Lower equity risk than growth-oriented portfolios.
Higher fixed income exposure makes duration and rate shock sensitivity visible.

name: Athena Tech Concentration Portfolio
investment_objective: High-growth concentrated equity exposure used to demonstrate risk warnings, stress losses and limit breaches.
strategy_description: High-growth concentrated portfolio designed to demonstrate sector concentration, single-name risk and stress testing.
ips_summary: Purposefully concentrated in technology and growth holdings; not designed as a prudent diversified allocation.
market_data_coverage: All holdings use deterministic Market Data demo price histories.
fixed_income_assumptions: Small BND allocation uses demo duration assumptions.
commentary_focus: High technology exposure and top-three concentration.
Designed to trigger Risk Monitor and Limit Center warnings.

fixed_income_assumptions: BND, IEF and TLT use demo duration, modified duration and DV01 assumptions.
